description: Active Phase 35 performance waivers. Waivers may cover temporary performance regressions only; correctness, timeout, diagnostics, cache-staleness, split-brain, and panic-safety failures are not waiverable.

waivers.rationale: Phase 37 added the Cargo-backed package-management workspace member. The command benchmarks execute through cargo run, so the checked-in command budgets now include stale Cargo workspace overhead rather than only the sifr binary path.
waivers.removal_criteria: Remove after issue #2148 recalibrates or redesigns command performance budgets for the Phase 37 workspace shape.
